# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue, discussion, or pull request for a security
vulnerability.

Report it privately through GitHub Security Advisories:

https://github.com/swmohamed/real-ui/security/advisories/new

If private reporting is unavailable on this repository, contact the repository
owner through GitHub without publishing exploit details.

Please include:

- a description of the issue and its impact
- steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept if you have one
- affected files, versions, or install paths when known

## What to expect

Maintainers will review private reports before any public disclosure. Please
give us time to investigate and prepare a fix.

We will typically:

1. Confirm receipt of the report
2. Assess impact and affected versions
3. Prepare a fix if the report is valid
4. Publish a GitHub Security Advisory when it is safe to do so

## Scope

This policy covers the REAL-UI repository and its install/research tooling:
skill files, scripts, tests, and published GitHub artifacts.

It does not cover third-party products used as research evidence, or copies of
this skill installed into other agents’ skill directories.

## Safe harbor

Good-faith vulnerability research is welcome. Do not access data that is not
yours, disrupt maintainers or users, or use a finding for anything other than
notifying this project.
